description: This file defines a class 'ADODB2_mssql' extending 'ADODB_DataDict' for handling Microsoft SQL Server database schema operations, including type mapping, SQL generation for altering tables, indexes, and column definitions, specifically tailored for MSSQL.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssql
classes.description: A class for MSSQL database schema manipulation and SQL generation, extending ADODB_DataDict.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps input type to MSSQL-specific type codes.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns MSSQL data type string based on meta code.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions, including default, identity, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes with options.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size/type string for MSSQL based on input parameters.
